title: CLIP: match an image with a caption
subtitle: Three scenes, three captions, two encoders. Score every image against every caption, train the scores for 60 steps, then classify by writing a candidate list instead of a class head.
audience: Students who have followed Vision I and know softmax and cross-entropy
centralLabel: One score for an image and a caption

sections.title: A fixed menu or an open caption
Three pairs and three named axes
Score every image against every caption

legendTitle: Whole-image and whole-caption vectors, not attention values
provenance: Scope: the image encoder is Vision I's trained encoder on the shared 8×8 scene, frozen; only a 4×3 map after it, a 14-word bag-of-words text map and one temperature learn, on three image–caption pairs for 60 SGD steps. Every number on this page is computed by that toy in your browser; the checked reference is train_vision3.py. This is a CLIP-style teaching toy, not pretrained CLIP.
